kind: One paired fullstack portal: same prompt, corpus, native permissions, root model, effort and budget; delegation capability differs.
root_selection: Native model/list confirms support and high effort. Matched supported root used in previous pairs; not a universal standard default.

scoring.visual: Fresh anonymous multi-screen review, 0–5 in half steps
scoring.bugs_iterations: Fresh review of distinct causes, fixes and targeted rechecks; separate duplicates, tooling, expected negatives, missing evidence and final reproductions.

measurement_boundary: Native root and explicit descendants; elapsed includes coordination, tools, preview waits, builder checks, fixes, audit packet and all owned native/backend/browser cleanup. Parent setup, negative preflight, external evaluation, independent audits and publication excluded. No images or subscription conversion.
limitations: Model choices, topology and implementations differ; no causal or general quality claim.
12 API and 11 frontend groups sample contracts; visual review is qualitative and uses one judge.
Successful approval and stale-conflict UI branches are not separate frozen browser probes; targeted final diagnosis is outside the group counts.
Native Chromium is blocked; both use the same parent fixed-origin preview browser with native backend hosting.
Native capabilities are alpha; shared host, provider and cache load are uncontrolled.

The 50-minute boundary reserves 30 seconds for bounded owned cleanup. Pathological OS or process-inspection delays can overrun it; measured elapsed and budget_exceeded retain any overshoot. No exact native token cap is available.
prompt_delivery: Same APP_PROMPT bytes via stdin, not condition-specific prompt text; native delegation feature/settings differ only. Assignedport runtime variable differs necessarily; no appserver runs beforetiming.

condition_isolation_amendment.reason: Legacy multi_agent/agents.enabled disable did not remove modern collaboration tools because shared runner enabled multi_agent_v2. Actual control child creation confirmed before external grading.
condition_isolation_amendment.adaptive_source: Original complete output copied byte-identically; no rerun or outcome repair. Effective native adaptive settings unchanged.
condition_isolation_amendment.fresh_control: Original common corpus and prompt; both modern and legacy coordination disabled, native visibility preflight required before start.
condition_isolation_amendment.condition_selection: Invalidated solely by actual helper creation, not product scores; no external evaluation has happened.
